name: docs-gardener
description: Keeps a project's markdown true to the project: deterministic checks (dead references, stale TODOs, duplicated paragraphs, orphans, dated series, oversized files, finished plans) at write time and from a docs_check tool, and /docs audit, which adds a model edit plan you apply item by item from a pane, or all at once for a scheduled run. Only /docs audit calls a model (one Haiku call per flagged file by default).

model.title: Audit model
model.description: The model /docs audit asks for an edit plan, one call per flagged or changed file, billed to your usage. Nothing else in the mod calls a model.

maxModelFiles.title: Files per audit sent to the model
maxModelFiles.description: The most files one /docs audit asks the model about; the rest keep their deterministic findings only.

staleDays.title: Days before a TODO is stale
staleDays.description: A TODO, FIXME, TBD, XXX line or an unchecked - [ ] item whose last commit (git blame) is older than this is flagged. A doc git does not track yet has no history, so none of its markers is stale.

orphanDays.title: Days before an unlinked doc is an orphan
orphanDays.description: A doc no other doc links to is flagged when it has not been touched for this long while a path it references changed since.

seriesRollupAt.title: Dated files per folder before a roll-up
seriesRollupAt.description: A folder holding more than this many files named with a date (2026-10-07) is offered a roll-up; the dailies are never deleted.

maxLines.title: Lines before a doc is oversized
maxLines.description: A doc with more lines than this is flagged as oversized: split it by topic or move the reference material out.

excludeGlobs.title: Extra paths to leave alone
excludeGlobs.description: Globs relative to the repo root, separated by commas, such as docs/generated/**, CHANGELOG.md. node_modules, third_party, vendor, .venv, venv, site-packages, dist, build and .git are always left out.

writeTimeChecks.title: Check docs as Claude writes them
writeTimeChecks.description: After each Write or Edit of a markdown file in scope, run the deterministic checks on it and tell Claude what they found. Never blocks or edits.
